title: POT 21 - Intermediate Level 2 Wheel (Soda Firing) (Tobin)
cost_text: Included in tuition with $98 pass-through supply fee for clay, glazes, and 2,000 cubic inches of firing space
source_quote: POT 21 - Intermediate Level 2 Wheel (Soda Firing) (Tobin) - Atlanta, GA September 10 - November 05, 2026
evidence_sentence: This class introduces students to the atmospheric firing process of soda in a cross-draft kiln where participants learn kiln loading, firing preparation, and unloading.
evidence_quote: This class introduces students to the atmospheric firing process of soda in a cross-draft kiln. Students will take part in kiln loading, firing preparation, and unloading.
summary: An intermediate soda firing class held Thursdays from September to November 2026 at Callanwolde Fine Arts Center. Registration is closed.
